snippet.title: Escape from Mental Hospital 👁️ | Official Horror Escape Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Step inside the terrifying walls of the abandoned mental hospital and uncover the dark secrets that haunt Sophie Wexler. 🕯️
This horror escape game challenges your mind with puzzles, mysteries, and shocking twists. Will you survive the experiments… or lose your sanity?

👉 Play now and experience the fear.
📲 Available on Android & iOS.

#EscapeFromMentalHospital #HorrorGame #MobileGames
